data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 reduces to SRC_001 because the uniqueness and bracketing proof (D(299)=789, D(300)=792, D(301)=795) depends on the base-10 digit-width partition mechanism (9 + 180 + 3k = 792) defined in SRC_001.
